title: RoadRunner Scenario
text: Define interface for Simulink actor model; {Action name} sets the name of user-defined, {Bus object name} sets the name of bus, {Event name} sets the name of user-defined and {Maximum Points on Path} sets the maximum number of points on path. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Maximum Points on Path
params.values: Maximum number of points on path 500 (default) | positive scalar
